items.title: J&J's MedTech Performance Slows in Q2: Will Sales Improve in H2?
items.summary: J&J's MedTech growth slowed down in Q2 as Cardiovascular lagged, but new product launches and stronger Vision, Surgery and Orthopedics may lift H2 sales.

items.title: The Buyback Machine Hiding Behind Cardinal Health's Thin Margins
items.summary: A steadily shrinking share count and a giant float owed to suppliers are handing owners a bigger slice of the drug distributor each year, even as drug-pricing worries hang over the stock.

items.title: Is Abbott Stock Attractive After Its Earnings and Guidance Update?
items.summary: ABT's earnings beat and higher profit outlook strengthen its case, but can growth in devices and diagnostics overcome valuation and acquisition concerns?

items.title: Medtronic continues assembly of industry’s “broadest” pain therapy portfolio
items.summary: Medtronic formally launched ViaVerte at ASPN 2026, with its $650m acquisition of SPR Therapeutics completing at the meeting’s outset on 16 July.

items.title: Johnson & Johnson Now Leads Its Pitch With An Oncology Bet
items.summary: The company that used to reassure you with its sheer breadth now leads with a push to dominate oncology, and a holder who bought a diversified compounder should notice the bet has changed shape.

items.title: Johnson & Johnson Is Becoming A Narrower Company Than You Bought
items.summary: Management's plain health care label has slipped out of the lead, and the business now on a separation clock is the one that finally started working.

items.title: Intuitive Surgical Stock Is On Sale, But Is The Growth Story Changing?
items.summary: The robotic surgery leader's shares have pulled back, forcing investors to weigh a solid recovery record against new questions in its most important market.

items.title: 6 Medical-Device Stocks to Buy After a Massive Selloff
items.summary: Device makers with cash flow yields of 5% to 6% now trade at a 20% to 30% discount to the S&P 500 index.
